title: Rendezvous Planning from Sparse Observations of Optimally Controlled Targets
summary: We develop a probabilistic framework for \emph{rendezvous planning}: given sparse, noisy observations of a fast-moving target, plan rendezvous spatiotemporal coordinates for a set of significantly slower seeking agents. The unknown target trajectory is estimated under uncertain dynamics using a filtering approach that combines a kernel-based maximum a posteriori estimation with Gaussian process correction, producing a mixture over trajectory hypotheses.
